origin.rerun: Read section D.6 of the spec. Check that breakout_1 is still a DXtrade account (config/accounts.yaml breakout_1; Breakout FAQ https://intercom.help/breakoutprop/en/articles/14215629) and that the D.6 infeasibility list has not already been triggered.

what: OPERATOR DECISION (W6-P3 automation spec, option D): authorise the READ-ONLY feasibility probe for driving breakout_1's DXtrade account from our VM. Step 0 is a documented DXtrade REST login plus one read (this is option C). Steps 1-2 are a Playwright read-only login and a 72h session keep-alive. It needs BREAKOUT_DX_USERNAME/PASSWORD/DOMAIN as Actions secrets, which the operator originates, and a Tier-2 secret sync to the VM. No order-placing code is involved; that is a later held Tier-2 PR. -- UPDATE 2026-09-27 ~10:05Z (session_01Ddb4V5PQhti4j4R6fQk6Ds): (a) The probe design CHANGED. The operator corrected the platform: they believe breakout_1 is on the proprietary Breakout Terminal, not DXtrade. First-party sources cannot settle it per account. Breakout's DXtrade white-label is itself titled 'Breakout Terminal' (MEASURED: curl https://wss.breakoutprop.com/ returned 200, <title>Breakout Terminal</title>, TOTP issuer dxTrade5). The old step 0, a DXtrade REST login, is DROPPED: /dxsca-web/ returns '403 RBAC: access denied' before auth. NEW step 0 = one operator answer: does breakout_1 open via dashboard 'Open Terminal' (portal.breakoutprop.com, proprietary) or via app.breakoutprop.com (DXtrade)? Spec section 'Which platform' and D.6 in docs/research/prop-automation-options-2026-09-27.md. (b) AUTHORISATION: the operator pre-authorised a READ-ONLY probe by popup ~09:42Z, CONDITIONAL on the platform being established from first-party sources first. That condition is NOT met, so no probe code has been written. (c) SECRETS, names only, never values in chat or PRs; they go in GitHub Actions secrets and then the existing sync-vm-secrets route. DXtrade branch: BREAKOUT_DX_USERNAME, BREAKOUT_DX_PASSWORD, plus BREAKOUT_DX_TOTP_SEED only if 2FA is on. Proprietary branch: BREAKOUT_PORTAL_EMAIL, BREAKOUT_PORTAL_PASSWORD, plus BREAKOUT_PORTAL_TOTP_SEED only if authenticator 2FA exists; an emailed code on every login makes that branch infeasible. (d) Next: the manager asks the operator the step-0 question and records the answer here; then this lane builds the Tier-2 held read-only probe PR for that platform. -- UPDATE 2026-09-27 ~10:20Z: STEP 0 RESOLVED. The operator (chat, ~10:17Z, relayed by the manager) said verbatim: 'I open and login through this link: https://app.breakoutprop.com/'. Breakout FAQ 14215629 maps that URL to DXTrade accounts, so breakout_1 is DXtrade. The pre-authorised READ-ONLY probe condition is MET, and the probe is being built as a Tier-2 held PR from branch claude/w6-prop-apex-eval. SECRETS the operator must add, names only: BREAKOUT_DX_USERNAME, BREAKOUT_DX_PASSWORD, and BREAKOUT_DX_TOTP_SEED only if 2FA is on for the account. They go in GitHub Actions secrets and are propagated to the VM by the existing sync-vm-secrets workflow. Never put values in chat or PRs. -- UPDATE 2026-09-27 ~10:40Z: PROBE BUILD PAUSED. Drafting the probe (a Playwright read-only login to breakout_1 on the live VM) was stopped by this session's permission layer, which flagged it as a production read. No probe code was committed or pushed. The operator must decide whether to allow this lane to build it (a permission setting), or route the build to a session that holds that permission. Secrets still to add, names only: BREAKOUT_DX_USERNAME, BREAKOUT_DX_PASSWORD, and BREAKOUT_DX_TOTP_SEED only if 2FA is on. -- UPDATE 2026-09-27 (lane session_01TnHSxwJD7n2vNMo4aiBt2k, branch claude/w6-breakout-dx-build, dispatched by manager session_01Ljhs6sFAdWHdMDhJpL5aBP): SLICE 1 BUILT as a held Tier-2 PR from that branch (PR number in the PR list for the branch). It contains: the spec re-scoped to the operator's ~10:52Z direction (support question, option C and is-it-allowed gating removed; ToS risk is one accepted line in the account risk assessment) plus a platform-adapter boundary (config/prop_platforms.yaml, platform: dxtrade | breakout_terminal); src/prop/platform/ with a dxtrade read-path adapter (login selectors MEASURED from Breakout's DXtrade login markup; post-login read keyed on labels/table headers, NOT MEASURED) and a scoped-only breakout_terminal adapter; scripts/prop/breakout_login_check.py and system-action breakout-login-check (Tier-2, read-only, no order control, emit-status default OFF). NOT in the PR: the sync-vm-secrets.yml entry for BREAKOUT_DX_USERNAME/BREAKOUT_DX_PASSWORD. The lane's edit adding the two names as OPTIONAL secrets (OPTIONAL_SECRETS plus the two env blocks 'Report OPTIONAL secrets presence' and 'Sync secrets to VM') was refused by the lane session's permission layer, so it was not made. Until a permitted session makes that edit and the sync runs, the login check exits 'feasibility: no_credentials'. Next: (1) add the two names to sync-vm-secrets.yml and dispatch it (label sync-vm-secrets-request); (2) merge the PR; (3) dispatch system-action breakout-login-check (reason required; apply: install-deps if the first run reports 'environment: chromium failed to launch'); (4) record the result here.
